title: F10: the sub-cent rule proven where it renders
desiredOutcome: Breaking the cost delegation in _report_usage turns at least one of its own cases red by name, exactly as the tokens side already does.

tasks.title: sub-cent fixture asserted through the rendered tile
tasks.description: TDD: FIRST break the fmt_cost delegation (e.g. bypass _fmt for costs) and confirm the existing 49 cases stay green - that is the bug, reproduced. THEN add the case: a fixture ledger row with spend under $0.01 asserted through the RENDERED string (_tile or _usage_tiles output must carry '<$0.01'), confirm it is red against the broken delegation by name, restore the delegation, confirm 50+ green. The rule is then proven where it renders, not only where it is defined.

add: a sub-cent spend renders as <$0.01 through the tile, red when the delegation breaks
